messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> inference-queue-prod • Severity: P1 • Reason: sustained queue_depth > 6500 (10m) • Link: https://pd.redwood/p/6240009876

pagerduty-bot: Page routed to rotation `sre-oncall` (oncall-aaron) — escalation policy: critical-service

oncall-aaron: ack — I'm on. Triage starting. Which cell is hot?

maria-ops: prod-eu-1 is the hot cell. Observed backlog on router/dispatcher pods. HPA desired=150 current=78, CPU ~96% on many pods. Autoscaler not triggering additional node spinups for GPUs.

oncall-aaron: copying logs now. Initial hypothesis: autoscaler missed launch due to quota or API rate-limiting. Pulling HPA and cluster events.

maria-ops: paste from events: `FailedCreate: insufficient quota` appears repeatedly in node-pool-scaler events at 17:36:21 UTC. Also a bunch of kube-scheduler backoff entries.

oncall-aaron: ok, manual mitigation while we investigate. Scaling inference-router to 200 replicas to force more pods onto existing capacity and enable reserved pool burst.

oncall-aaron: ```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-router --replicas=200
kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-router -o wide
kubectl -n kube-system describe events | grep -i quota
```

james-platform: I'm on the thread (escalation). Checking cloud quotas now — eu-west1 GPU quota at 100/100 used, can't request more instantly. I'll open emergency quota and also look for spare capacity in other regions.

elena-support: CS note — multiple customers reporting timeouts on text-gen endpoints, creating ticket CS-1089 with impacted tenant list. Reported error spikes: 502/504 around 17:34–17:46 UTC.

maria-ops: kvcache metrics show eviction spikes at queue surge time; large cold prefixes caused regen storms — many requests redoing expensive context generation. That amplified token load.

oncall-aaron: mitigation step 2: enabled throttles for experimental routes and downgraded model routing for non-SLA tenants to reduce token load. Patching routing rules now.

oncall-aaron: ```
# temporary route change (proxy):
PATCH /v1/routes/route-id
{ "route": { "model_override": "small-quantized", "rate_limit": 50 } }
```

james-platform: Also enabling reserved-dedicated-node pool (burst) and asking infra to move some workloads to preemptible-safe instances. Sending request to infra-ops.

elena-support: Update posted to affected customers: "We're investigating queue saturation and applying mitigations — you may see improved latency within 30 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria-ops: Quick note — spike source looks like a single tenant running large-scale evals (tenant-42). We've applied a tenant-level throttle to their API key.

oncall-aaron: manual node spin-up attempted but hit quota. Workaround: used reserved pool and increased pod replica count to absorb backlog. Queues now decreasing but still elevated.

oncall-aaron: current metrics: queue_depth peaked ~7.2k -> now ~1.2k over 18 minutes. Error rate for /v1/generate dropped from ~12% -> ~4%.

james-platform: filed INFRA-789 (autoscaler policy tuning + quota playbook). Autoscaler has a race against cache regen bursts; we need a policy to prewarm nodes for kvcache-wide misses.

oncall-lina: taking 2nd shift handoff in 18m. Handing over context: scaled replicas -> 170 (stabilizing), reserved nodes enabled, tenant-42 throttled; PD link and CS ticket created. I'll monitor for 60m and run post-incident checks.

elena-support: CS pushed proactive update to top-10 impacted customers — waiting on confirmation for SLA credit assessment.

oncall-lina: adding follow-ups: 1) revert experimental routes blocked 2) run targeted cache prewarm for top prefixes 3) postmortem.

incident-bot: Postmortem draft created: https://incidents.redwood/6240009876/draft — checklist includes timeline, root-cause hypothesis, mitigation, and action items.

james-platform: Action items assigned: INFRA-789 (autoscaler policy), SERVE-402 (prewarm kvcache paths), SRE-615 (better PD routing + quota failover). I'll own INFRA-789.

elena-support: keeping CS synced — next customer update in 30m, will escalate to enterprise success if issues persist.

oncall-lina: final note before takeover: leave monitoring window 45m post-reduction. If queue_depth < 500 for 30m, mark mitigated and start RCA.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded: oncall-aaron acknowledged at 17:38:04 UTC, escalation to james-platform at 17:42:10 UTC.

oncall-lina: handoff complete — monitoring now.
